data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=QPiJqllYwUUQ7kNvgEISGJf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDYsPS2KRgqE-z6X_a3XhdTrF6y3fO--ucAv5BEUchClw&oe=672B539C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg4-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=z2I0boFmPagQ7kNvgHx4fS0&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg4-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA-sWcNIczCYVY7E7h0-NbNEGLl-ePoUisHIt2YJFIqDQ&oe=672B5D24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg4-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NU9r5Rz4Wx4Q7kNvgEOiRMD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg4-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCCQflZuhJESR5YqWPSRrpDB-EKlSZFhdBJWvfZDDLhag&oe=672B4487)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=fAPpNvEfILcQ7kNvgEvVtQ-&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBWR8rbH21SWhxk61Vl7mGvHcj_kOLVsIqJZNkhBWH2Cg&oe=672B3766)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=DfHI_3va92kQ7kNvgEDvvDB&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDPzSROACjdTzIXVlze95ZoCdJd8oIAUQUcJVBu5rAfzg&oe=672B63D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg1-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ot1yIfmGPeAQ7kNvgHmTH7X&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg1-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAV2w3Y72Y_2osvs3p6vrJ4uzUFZqFBu8amoGgLvIDe6g&oe=672B6059)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=miTym6xW2jwQ7kNvgFwf86r&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBRSmX4WQ5TjNzNlu-vD1u5mRouMV3KdLkS8HkmPT4Rwg&oe=672B4670)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg1-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=LuFYQKXi7VAQ7kNvgGflfsx&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg1-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAR2h-E0bvJMyFpPa8xXoIwWUom_SywjvNs-UH-Ambc3A&oe=672B692A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qdnFIPmOT2cQ7kNvgHzhHCf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBUfkQTqYdqU9nj75leQneouZ6JX41Sr4Wnp-67nF0tfw&oe=672B4497)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-hkg1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=LsU05WT7uDwQ7kNvgFt8AY1&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-hkg1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCHQ7N541YdWizBN7Ph9SfHUhWVNb3JrpAUi6PfiDXhsg&oe=672B600C)
